summary: The user deposited about 500 dollars in Bitcoin to NeoxEX to purchase BTCB2 after the platform promoted itself as an early exchange listing the token. The Bitcoin transaction received more than 18 confirmations but the deposited funds did not appear in the exchange account.
user_mistake: deposited Bitcoin into an unverified exchange promoting a newly listed token
prevention: Confirm successful independent deposits and withdrawals before funding an unfamiliar exchange / Verify the exchange independently before transferring crypto
